themes.name: Dark (in-chat widgets only, prepared, not implemented)

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground (dawn mist). The trail-landscape illustration sits on it at the bottom of the window.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, rows. Everything the user reads or edits sits on surface. Dark: the in-chat widget ground is transparent; surface is only for raised parts (skeleton blocks, the mini pack interior).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Input wells, hover on rows, the empty backpack interior, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row hover and the inline-field hover hint on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel borders, row dividers, card edges. Decorative only, never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, toggles and tiles (3.4:1 on surface). Dark: 3.9:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-sunken (13.7:1 or better). Dark: 13.4:1 on dark surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: notes, labels, units, metadata. On bg, surface, surface-sunken (5.9:1 or better). Dark: 8.4:1.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels only. 4.7:1 on surface-sunken, 5.4:1 on surface. Dark: 6.0:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ember. Primary button fill, selected states, focus ring, active flag icons. White text on it is 5.2:1. Dark: brighter ember #E3784B, 5.3:1 on dark surface; text on it is on-accent (dark), 5.9:1.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover/pressed.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent used as TEXT (links, the selected tab label) on any light ground: 5.5:1 on surface-sunken. Dark: 7.2:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected tile/row background, active flag button background. Text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Dark: #1E171B (dark ink), because the dark-theme ember is light.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Success / connected state (data file saved). Pair with an icon, never colour alone. Dark: 7.6:1.

tokens.name: forest-soft
tokens.usage: Success banner background; text on it is ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons and error text. 5.4:1 on danger-soft. Dark: 6.6:1.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error banner background; destructive button hover on ghost.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon (file not connected). 5.6:1 on warning-soft. Dark: 8.5:1.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner background.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px surface gap.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dialog backdrop.

tokens.name: ridge-1
tokens.usage: Landscape: farthest ridge.

tokens.name: ridge-2
tokens.usage: Landscape: second ridge.

tokens.name: ridge-3
tokens.usage: Landscape: forested hills.

tokens.name: ridge-4
tokens.usage: Landscape: meadow with the trail.

tokens.name: ridge-5
tokens.usage: Landscape: foreground pines at the edges.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Landscape: the low sun disc; also the small sun in the logo mark.

tokens.name: cat-backpack
tokens.usage: Category colour, Backpack (rust). Backpack layer, legend swatch, category heading dot. Dark: same lightness order as light, 3:1 or better on the dark surface.

tokens.name: cat-shelter
tokens.usage: Category colour, Shelter System (moss). Dark: same lightness order as light, 3:1 or better on the dark surface.

tokens.name: cat-sleep
tokens.usage: Category colour, Sleep System (dusk plum). Dark: same lightness order as light, 3:1 or better on the dark surface.

tokens.name: cat-clothing
tokens.usage: Category colour, Clothing (apricot). Dark: same lightness order as light, 3:1 or better on the dark surface.

tokens.name: cat-cooking
tokens.usage: Category colour, Cooking (red rock). Dark: same lightness order as light, 3:1 or better on the dark surface.

tokens.name: cat-water
tokens.usage: Category colour, Water (lake). Dark: same lightness order as light, 3:1 or better on the dark surface.

tokens.name: cat-electronics
tokens.usage: Category colour, Electronics (sun). Dark: same lightness order as light, 3:1 or better on the dark surface.

tokens.name: cat-hygiene
tokens.usage: Category colour, Hygiene (lavender). Dark: same lightness order as light, 3:1 or better on the dark surface.

tokens.name: cat-food
tokens.usage: Category colour, Food (deep forest). Dark: same lightness order as light, 3:1 or better on the dark surface.

tokens.name: cat-misc
tokens.usage: Category colour, Misc (stone). Dark: same lightness order as light, 3:1 or better on the dark surface.

tokens.name: cat-custom-1
tokens.usage: First user-created category (rosehip). Custom categories take custom-1..4 in creation order, then repeat. Dark: same lightness order as light, 3:1 or better on the dark surface.

tokens.name: cat-custom-2
tokens.usage: Second user-created category (deep teal). Dark: same lightness order as light, 3:1 or better on the dark surface.

tokens.name: cat-custom-3
tokens.usage: Third user-created category (olive). Dark: same lightness order as light, 3:1 or better on the dark surface.

tokens.name: cat-custom-4
tokens.usage: Fourth user-created category (sand). Dark: same lightness order as light, 3:1 or better on the dark surface.

tokens.name: gsi-fill
tokens.usage: Sign in with Google button fill (Google's light-theme button spec). Web only. Do not restyle the Google button with HikingBuddy colours.

tokens.name: gsi-stroke
tokens.usage: Sign in with Google button border (Google spec).

tokens.name: gsi-text
tokens.usage: Sign in with Google button label (Google spec).

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The app name in the header. Only place display type is not uppercase.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Gearlist name at the top of the gearlist panel.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Panel headings (Gear Vault, Gearlists) and dialog titles. Uppercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: weight tiles, category headings, form labels, legend headers.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Item names, dialog text, everything editable.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Category names in rows, the selected option.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Compact controls and dense UI text: small buttons, banners, legend rows, the weight split under the pack, inline 'Add item'.

styles.name: weight
styles.usage: Weights and quantities in rows. Always tabular-nums, right-aligned.

styles.name: weight-xl
styles.usage: The pack weight next to the backpack and the Total tile. Tabular-nums.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The smallest text: badges, the tier hint, percentages inside the pack layers. Never smaller than this in the UI.

styles.name: w-title
styles.usage: Widget heading: gearlist or item name. Host font (the AI app's own), so the widget reads like the chat around it.

styles.name: w-body
styles.usage: Rows, descriptions, state messages inside widgets.

styles.name: w-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis in widgets: weights in rows, the change verb in a proposal.

styles.name: w-caption
styles.usage: Metadata, badges and the tier hint in widgets. Never smaller.

styles.name: w-total
styles.usage: The one big number in the pack summary widget (Total). Barlow Condensed, tabular-nums. With label (13px) this is the only brand type in widgets.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding, field gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding on narrow windows, dialog field stack.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding, dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between the two panels, between backpack block and item list.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top padding above the panels.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, badges, inline-edit wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Category tiles, weight tiles, banners, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Segmented control, flag toggles, count badges.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels floating above the landscape.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, dropdown menus, tooltips.

layout.note: Sizes for the in-chat widgets and the new web panels (PRD v33).

tokens.name: widget-min-width
tokens.usage: Narrowest chat column a widget must work in (mobile AI apps). No horizontal scrolling at this width.

tokens.name: widget-wide
tokens.usage: Container-query breakpoint inside widgets: at and above it the pack summary puts the category list beside the split, list rows show notes.

tokens.name: widget-rows-inline
tokens.usage: Gear list widget: rows shown before 'Show all N items'. Widgets never scroll inside themselves.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every control in widgets (always) and on touch devices on the web.

tokens.name: sheet-width
tokens.usage: Activity panel width on desktop (side sheet from the right). Full width under 560px.
